messages:
hana: Heads-up — opened a PR to consolidate console observability snippets (cost/latency + tracing hook) into a single 'snippet bundle'. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
sam: Nice. Does that change the SDK examples consumers rely on?
hana: I updated Node / Python / Go variants in the same bundle and kept the standalone curl example for quick smoke tests. Also added a short migration note.
marie: Please add a clear note about token breakdown. Reviewers missed the cost/latency delta between streaming vs non-streaming in the previous PRs.
jon: Left an inline comment on the PR about the trace header config — we should explicitly show an "x-trace-id" header example and a tiny trace->dashboard mapping.
hana: ACK, adding header example now. snippet preview:
```js
// SDK (node)
const resp = await redwood.chat.create({
  model: "open-runtime/redwood-v2",
  input: "Summarize logs",
  tracing: { headers: { "x-trace-id": "req-{{request.id}}" } }
});
```
marie: Also can we include a 1-liner query for the dashboard that filters by trace id? SQL/KQL/PromQL — one short example is enough.
jon: I added a KQL snippet in a follow-up commit and a note about time-range to avoid empty results.
docs-bot: CI: docs spellcheck passed ✅
sam: FYI CI examples failed link-check on the PR — missing internal link to /console/metrics. I pushed a tiny link fix in a separate commit.
hana: Thanks. Can we do a quick docs review tomorrow at 10:00am? Most comments are minor and I want to merge after CI clears.
marie: works for me :thumbsup:
jon: I can upload the dashboard query graphic to the PR if you want a visual for the trace filter.
hana: That would be great — thanks. Will merge after CI unless there are new blockers.
